inputs.title: Magnetic map of tau Boo from 12 polarised spectra of 13 June 2006 to 19 June 2006: radial, azimuthal and meridional field on a longitude-latitude grid
inputs.credit: CFHT ESPaDOnS, CFHT programs 06AF7B, 06AH20A, from the Canadian Astronomy Data Centre; reduced and mapped in this project with Korg 1.3.1, LSDpy 1.0.0, specpolFlow 1.1.0, ZDIpy. This research used the facilities of the Canadian Astronomy Data Centre operated by the National Research Council of Canada with the support of the Canadian Space Agency.
inputs.acquisition: The file the tepiamenit package holds for its own dataset radial-field-2006-06; Written by packages/telescope-cli/src/archives/espadons/reduce.mts with the program tau-boo-2006-06, which pins every archived spectrum by its size. The run's receipt (the line list, the codes and each step's result) is written again by that command under output/espadons and is not kept in git.
inputs.license: CC BY 4.0 for the archived spectra (Canadian Astronomy Data Centre); reduction by this project
